dedupe_keys.name: energy intensity data for public water supply in the united states

description: Robert B. Sowby and Steven J. Burian at the University of Utah publish empirical water-use and electricity-use observations for public water systems in the United States. The November 2017 version 1.0.0 archive is free under CC BY-SA 4.0. The linked GitHub README identifies three CSV tables containing metadata, field definitions and observed values. These records can inform energy-intensity assumptions in coupled water and electricity simulations, including pumping-cost or efficiency comparisons. The public summary leaves the number of systems, observation dates, geographical distribution within the country and specific energy-intensity units unknown. Ratios should therefore be interpreted only after checking the supplied field descriptions and system boundaries. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this collection. Repository metadata and the README were inspected, but the CSV contents and underlying measurement quality were not checked.
